raw.thesis: Narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" to help AI-first companies scale their AI automation efforts. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an Observe layer that captures work patterns, an Intelligence Layer that understands intent and identifies "drift," and an Execution Layer that generates and deploys AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. This system focuses on leveraging existing foundation models and understanding the "Work Graph" to optimize AI intervention. It aims to address the common enterprise challenges of lacking telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurement, and drift in systems and human resources. This venture appears to be a growth-oriented startup, given its focus on "at scale" deployment and "Continuous AI lift." The venture is currently at the idea stage, as evidenced by the conceptual description without mention of any built product or user traction. Narma positions itself as a complementary solution to existing foundation models, providing a meta-layer for orchestrating and optimizing their use within complex enterprise workflows.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited about building a single system that can observe work, decide on AI actions, and continuously auto-build agents for "Continuous AI lift."
raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture. The Observe Layer uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns. The Intelligence Layer acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value, and "drift" in workflows. The Execution Layer is an "Agent Factory" that automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. It leverages existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify areas for AI assistance and optimization.
things_that_must_work: Accuracy of desktop sensors in capturing work patterns
Effectiveness of the Intelligence Layer in detecting intent and drift
Reliability and security of automated agent generation and deployment

core_insight.source_excerpt: Vision: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a 'Continuous AI lift.'
core_insight.if_wrong: If companies cannot accurately observe and understand their work graphs, or if AI agents cannot be effectively deployed and monitored, then Narma will fail to deliver continuous AI lift and ROI.
core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on a holistic 'Work Graph' approach to AI automation, rather than just building individual agents or models, providing a continuous feedback loop and deployment mechanism.

raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma provides a comprehensive, three-layered approach to AI automation (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) that leverages existing foundation models, focusing on understanding the "Work Graph" to enable continuous and scalable AI agent deployment with built-in monitoring and approval.
